words.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ pose（放置）→ 把东西分开放好，或放到别处去 → 处理 / 处置
words.origin: 拉丁语 disponere：dis-（分开）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: to get rid of something, or to arrange things in a particular order
words.core_concept: placing things apart into their proper place – 把东西分开安置到该去的地方
words.core_image: 把桌上的东西一件件分类放进不同抽屉，桌面清空
examples: Please dispose of the packaging responsibly.
The troops were disposed along the ridge.
semantic_expansions: 布置：把东西分开摆到各自位置上
处理/处置：把东西放到'不在这里'的位置去，即丢弃。同一个'分开安置'，区别在放到哪儿

words.root_logic: sup-（sub- 的变体，表'在下面'）+ pose（放置）→ 先在底下垫一个前提 → 假定
words.origin: 拉丁语 supponere：sub-（在下）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: to think something is probably true, or to take it as a starting assumption
words.core_concept: placing an assumption underneath as a base – 在推理底下先垫一个前提
words.core_image: 搭台子前先在底下塞一块砖，整个台面靠它撑着
examples: Suppose the train is late — what then?
I suppose you're right.
semantic_expansions: 假定：明确在底下垫一个前提，用来往下推
认为/料想：口语里把这个'垫底的判断'说得轻一些，实质仍是未经证实的前提

words.root_logic: compose（放在一起）+ -ition → 放在一起的方式，或放好的成品 → 构成 / 作品
words.origin: 拉丁语 compositio：com-（一起）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: the way parts are put together, or a piece of writing or music that results
words.core_concept: how parts are placed together – 各部分被放在一起的方式，及其成品
words.core_image: 摄影师在取景框里挪动每个元素，直到画面各就各位
examples: The composition of the soil affects growth.
She wrote a composition about her hometown.
The photograph's composition draws the eye upward.
semantic_expansions: 构成/构图：强调各部分被放在一起的那种方式
作文/作曲：把词句或音符放在一起得到的成品。同一个'放在一起'，一个指方式一个指结果

words.root_logic: sub-（在下）+ mit（送）→ 把东西往上级下方送去 → 提交 / 服从
words.origin: 拉丁语 submittere：sub-（在下）+ mittere（送）
words.native_definition: to hand something in for consideration, or to yield to a stronger force
words.core_concept: sending something under another's authority – 把东西或自己送到对方权威之下
words.core_image: 把文件双手递到柜台后的人手里，决定权就此交出去
examples: Please submit your application before Friday.
The rebels refused to submit.
semantic_expansions: 提交：把材料送到对方那里，由对方裁决
服从/屈服：把自己送到对方权威之下。同一个'送到下方'，区别只在送的是文件还是自己

words.root_logic: dis-（离开）+ miss（送）→ 把人送走 → 解散 / 解雇 / 不予考虑
words.origin: 拉丁语 dimittere：dis-（离开）+ mittere（送）
words.native_definition: to send someone away, or to refuse to take an idea seriously
words.core_concept: sending someone or something away from here – 把人或念头送离此处
words.core_image: 老师一挥手，整班学生起身离开教室
examples: The teacher dismissed the class early.
He was dismissed for repeated absences.
The judge dismissed the case.
semantic_expansions: 解散/解雇：把人送出这个场所或岗位
驳回：把一个主张送出考虑范围。三个中文词共享'送走、不留在这里'这一个动作

words.root_logic: permit（让…通过）+ -sion → 允许通过这件事本身 → 许可
words.origin: 拉丁语 permissio：per-（通过）+ mittere（送）
words.native_definition: official agreement that lets someone do something
words.core_concept: the act of letting something pass through – 放行这件事本身
words.core_image: 闸口抬起横杆，车辆得以通过
examples: You need written permission to enter the site.
She gave permission for the photo to be used.
semantic_expansions: 许可与允许：都是把横杆抬起来让对方通过，区别只在是否落成书面形式

words.root_logic: a-（ad- 的变体，表'朝向'）+ spect（看）→ 朝某个方向看到的那一面 → 方面
words.origin: 拉丁语 aspectus：ad-（朝向）+ specere（看）
words.native_definition: one of the sides or features of something being considered
words.core_concept: the face something shows from one viewing angle – 从某个角度看过去所呈现的那一面
words.core_image: 同一座山，从东面看是峭壁，从南面看是缓坡
examples: We must consider every aspect of the plan.
The room has a southern aspect.
semantic_expansions: 方面：从某个角度审视一件事时露出的那一面
朝向/外观：建筑面朝哪边，即它把哪一面呈现给你看。同一个'从某方向看到的面'

words.root_logic: per-（透过）+ spect（看）→ 透过某个位置看出去的整体样子 → 视角 / 透视
words.origin: 拉丁语 perspicere：per-（透过）+ specere（看）
words.native_definition: a particular way of viewing things, or the technique of showing depth on a flat surface
words.core_concept: the whole view obtained from one standpoint – 站在某一点看出去所得到的整体图景
words.core_image: 站在铁轨中央，两条平行线在远处收成一个点
examples: From a historian's perspective, the treaty changed little.
The drawing uses one-point perspective.
semantic_expansions: 透视法：绘画上把三维深度画到平面上的技法，直接对应'透过一点看出去'
视角/观点：把这个站位从物理位置引申为立场，看到的图景随之不同

words.root_logic: spect（看）+ -acle（表工具或对象）→ 值得看的那个东西 → 壮观场面
words.native_definition: an impressive or unusual sight that people gather to watch
words.core_concept: something staged to be watched – 专门摆出来供人观看的场面
words.core_image: 广场上焰火升空，人群齐齐仰头
examples: The opening ceremony was a spectacle.
He polished his spectacles on his sleeve.
semantic_expansions: 壮观场面/奇观：被摆出来让人看的那个对象
眼镜（复数 spectacles）：用来看的那个器具——同一个词根落到工具上，这是独立引申的一支

words.root_logic: propose（往前放）+ -al → 被放到台面上的那个方案 → 提议
words.origin: 拉丁语 proponere：pro-（向前）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: a plan or suggestion put forward for others to consider
words.core_concept: what has been placed forward for consideration – 被推到台面上供人评议的那个东西
words.core_image: 会议桌上被推到中间的一份方案，所有人都看得见
examples: The committee rejected the proposal.
She accepted his proposal.
semantic_expansions: 提议/方案：被推到众人面前等待评议的内容
求婚：把终身大事推到对方面前等一个答复——同样是'放到前面等回应'

words.root_logic: transmit（送过去）+ -sion → 送过去这件事，或负责送的那套装置 → 传输 / 变速箱
words.origin: 拉丁语 transmissio：trans-（穿过）+ mittere（送）
words.native_definition: the act of sending something across a distance, or the part that carries power to the wheels
words.core_concept: the passing of something across a gap – 把某物从这一端送到那一端
words.core_image: 信号沿着电缆一路传到对岸的接收站
examples: Data transmission slows during peak hours.
Masks reduce transmission of the virus.
The car's transmission needs repair.
semantic_expansions: 传输/传播：把数据或病毒从一端送到另一端
变速箱：把发动机动力送到车轮的那套机构——从'送'这个动作引申为承担送的装置

words.root_logic: respect（回头看）+ -ive → 逐个回头看清各自对应的那个 → 各自的
words.native_definition: belonging separately to each of the people or things mentioned
words.core_concept: looking back at each one separately – 逐个回看，把各自对应的关系分清
words.core_image: 颁奖后各人拿着自己那一份奖状回到各自座位
examples: After the meeting they returned to their respective offices.
The two firms kept their respective logos.
semantic_expansions: 各自的与分别的：都是逐个回看、把对应关系一一分清，中文两种译法对应同一个动作
